Settings.QueryText: SELECT Reservations.Number AS RefNumber, Reservations.Date AS RefDate, Reservations.Hotel AS Hotel, Reservations.ClientType AS ClientType, Reservations.ClientType.Code AS ClientTypeCode, ISNULL(Reservations.ClientType.ColorHexString, "") AS ClientTypeColorHexString, Reservations.SourceOfBusiness.Code AS SourceOfBusinessCode, Reservations.SourceOfBusiness AS SourceOfBusiness, Reservations.MarketingCode.Code AS MarketingCodeCode, Reservations.MarketingCode AS MarketingCode, Reservations.Guest AS Guest, Reservations.Guest.IsInWhiteList AS VIP, Reservations.Guest.MilitaryRank AS Rank, DiscountTypes.Ref AS DiscountCardDiscountType, ISNULL(DiscountTypes.ColorHexString, "") AS DiscountCardDiscountTypeColorHexString, Reservations.Guest.FullName AS GuestFullName, Reservations.Guest.Citizenship.ISOCode AS GuestCitizenshipISOCode, Reservations.Guest.DateOfBirth AS GuestDateOfBirth, CASE WHEN Reservations.Guest <> VALUE(Catalog.Clients.EmptyRef) THEN CASE WHEN Reservations.Guest.DateOfBirth > DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND (DATEADD(Reservations.Guest.DateOfBirth, YEAR, DATEDIFF(Reservations.Guest.DateOfBirth, Reservations.CheckInDate, YEAR)) BETWEEN BEGINOFPERIOD(Reservations.CheckInDate, DAY) AND Reservations.CheckOutDate) THEN 55 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS BirthDateIcon, Reservations.Guest.Age AS GuestAge, Reservations.Guest.AgeRange AS GuestAgeRange, CASE WHEN Reservations.Guest.Sex = VALUE(Enum.Sex.Male) THEN 26 WHEN Reservations.Guest.Sex = VALUE(Enum.Sex.Female) THEN 27 ELSE 0 END AS GuestSexIcon, CASE WHEN Reservations.Phone <> "" THEN Reservations.Phone ELSE Reservations.Guest.Phone END AS Phone, CASE WHEN Reservations.EMail <> "" THEN Reservations.EMail ELSE Reservations.Guest.EMail END AS EMail, Reservations.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, Reservations.GuestGroup.Code AS GuestGroupCode, Reservations.GuestGroup.Description AS GuestGroupDescription, Reservations.GuestGroup.ID AS GuestGroupID, Reservations.GuestGroup.ColorHexString AS GuestGroupColorHexString, Reservations.Room AS Room, Reservations.RoomType AS RoomType, Reservations.RoomType.Code AS RoomTypeCode, Reservations.RoomTypeUpgrade AS RoomTypeUpgrade, Reservations.RoomTypeUpgrade.Code AS RoomTypeUpgradeCode, Reservations.ReservationStatus AS ReservationStatus, ReservationStatuses.Code AS ReservationStatusCode, ReservationStatuses.Description AS ReservationStatusDescription, ReservationStatuses.IsArrivalSchedule AS ReservationStatusIsArrivalSchedule, ReservationStatuses.ColorHexString AS ReservationStatusColorHexString, Reservations.GuaranteeType AS GuaranteeType, Reservations.GuaranteeType.Code AS GuaranteeTypeCode, Reservations.Customer AS Customer, ISNULL(Reservations.Customer.ColorHexString, "") AS CustomerColorHexString, Reservations.Contract AS Contract, ISNULL(Reservations.Contract.ColorHexString, "") AS ContractColorHexString, Reservations.Agent AS Agent, ISNULL(Reservations.Agent.ColorHexString, "") AS AgentColorHexString, Reservations.AccommodationTemplate AS AccommodationTemplate, Reservations.AccommodationType AS AccommodationType, Reservations.CheckInDate AS CheckInDate, Reservations.Duration AS Duration, Reservations.CheckOutDate AS CheckOutDate, CASE WHEN Reservations.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime <> DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND HOUR(Reservations.CheckInDate) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.CheckInDate) = HOUR(Reservations.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime) THEN TRUE WHEN Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour <> DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND Reservations.RoomRate.DefaultCheckInTime = DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND HOUR(Reservations.CheckInDate) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.CheckInDate) = HOUR(Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsDefaultCheckInTime, CASE WHEN Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour <> DATETIME(1, 1, 1) AND HOUR(Reservations.CheckOutDate) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.CheckOutDate) = HOUR(Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) * 100 + MINUTE(Reservations.RoomRate.ReferenceHour) THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS IsDefaultCheckOutTime, Reservations.RoomRate AS RoomRate, Reservations.ServicePackage AS ServicePackage, Reservations.PlannedPaymentMethod AS PlannedPaymentMethod, Reservations.PlannedPaymentMethod.Code AS PlannedPaymentMethodCode, Reservations.RoomQuota AS RoomQuota, ISNULL(Reservations.RoomQuota.ColorHexString, "") AS RoomQuotaColorHexString, CAST(Reservations.RoomPropertiesCodes AS STRING(512)) AS RoomPropertiesCodes, CAST(Reservations.RoomPropertiesDescriptions AS STRING(512)) AS RoomPropertiesDescriptions, CAST(Reservations.Remarks AS STRING(512)) AS Remarks, CAST(Reservations.HousekeepingRemarks AS STRING(512)) AS HousekeepingRemarks, CAST(Reservations.Car AS STRING(512)) AS Car, Reservations.NumberOfPersons AS NumberOfPersons, Reservations.NumberOfAdults AS NumberOfAdults, Reservations.NumberOfTeenagers AS NumberOfTeenagers, Reservations.NumberOfChildren AS NumberOfChildren, Reservations.NumberOfInfants AS NumberOfInfants, Reservations.AccommodationType.SortCode AS AccommodationTypeSortCode, Reservations.Room.SortCode AS RoomSortCode, Reservations.AccommodationType.Type AS AccommodationTypeType, CASE WHEN ISNULL(Reservations.HotelProduct.IsFolder, FALSE) THEN Reservations.HotelProduct ELSE Reservations.HotelProduct.Parent END AS VaucherType, CASE WHEN ISNULL(Reservations.HotelProduct.IsFolder, FALSE) THEN UNDEFINED ELSE Reservations.HotelProduct END AS Vaucher, 0 AS ClientSumBalance, 0 AS CustomerSumBalance, 0 AS ClientLimitBalance, Reservations.ReportingCurrency AS FolioCurrency, CASE WHEN Reservations.ParentDoc <> UNDEFINED THEN 53 WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsInWaitingList THEN 54 WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsActive THEN CASE WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsGuaranteed THEN 44 ELSE 42 END WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsCheckIn THEN 36 WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsNoShow THEN 51 WHEN ReservationStatuses.IsPreliminary THEN 35 ELSE 43 END AS IDIconStatus, Reservations.Ref AS Ref, Reservations.RoomQuantity AS RoomQuantity, CASE WHEN NOT Reservations.RoomTypeUpgrade.Code IS NULL AND Reservations.RoomTypeUpgrade <> Reservations.RoomType THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS RoomTypeUpgradeIsDone, CAST(Reservations.PricePresentation AS STRING(50)) AS PricePresentation, Reservations.Author AS Author, Reservations.Posted AS Posted, Reservations.SortCode AS SortCode, Reservations.Company AS Company, Reservations.BedsSetup AS BedsSetup, Reservations.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.Period AS ReservationStatusSetTime, &qShowAllGuests AS ShowAllGuests, &qBalancesAreVisible AS BalancesAreVisible, 0 AS RowColorIndex FROM Document.Reservation AS Reservations LEFT JOIN Catalog.ReservationStatuses AS ReservationStatuses ON Reservations.ReservationStatus = ReservationStatuses.Ref LEFT JOIN Catalog.DiscountTypes AS DiscountTypes ON Reservations.DiscountCard.DiscountType = DiscountTypes.Ref LEFT JOIN InformationRegister.ReservationChangeHistory.SliceLast( &qEndOfDate, CASE WHEN &qSearchByChangeDate THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS ReservationLastState ON Reservations.Ref = ReservationLastState.Reservation LEFT JOIN InformationRegister.ReservationChangeHistory.SliceLast( , CASE WHEN &qShowStatusLastChangeTime THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END) AS ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords ON Reservations.Ref = ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.Reservation WHERE CASE WHEN &qHotelIsFilled THEN Reservations.Hotel IN (&qHotel) ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qShowAllGuests = 0 THEN Reservations.AccommodationTemplate <> VALUE(Catalog.AccommodationTemplates.EmptyRef) ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qShowAll THEN TRUE WHEN &qShowNotPostedOnly THEN NOT Reservations.Posted WHEN &qShowActiveOnly THEN Reservations.Posted AND NOT ReservationStatuses.IsArrivalSchedule AND (ReservationStatuses.IsActive OR ReservationStatuses.IsPreliminary) ELSE Reservations.Posted AND CASE WHEN &qSearchByChangeDate THEN ReservationLastState.ReservationStatus = &qReservationStatus ELSE Reservations.ReservationStatus = &qReservationStatus END END AND CASE WHEN &qDateIsFilled THEN CASE WHEN &qSearchByCheckInDate THEN Reservations.CheckInDate BETWEEN &qDate AND &qDateTo WHEN &qSearchByStayDate THEN Reservations.CheckOutDate >= &qDate AND Reservations.CheckInDate <= &qDateTo WHEN &qSearchByCheckOutDate THEN Reservations.CheckOutDate BETWEEN &qDate AND &qDateTo WHEN &qSearchByCreateDate THEN Reservations.Date BETWEEN &qDate AND &qDateTo WHEN &qSearchByChangeDate THEN ReservationLastState.Period BETWEEN &qDate AND &qDateTo WHEN &qSearchByStatusChangeDate THEN ReservationStatusChangeHistoryRecords.Period BETWEEN &qDate AND &qDateTo ELSE TRUE END ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qAuthorIsFilled THEN CASE WHEN &qSearchByChangeDate THEN ReservationLastState.User = &qAuthor ELSE Reservations.Author = &qAuthor END ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qGuestGroupIsFilled THEN Reservations.GuestGroup = &qGuestGroup ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qCustomerIsFilled THEN Reservations.Customer IN HIERARCHY (&qCustomer) ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qContractIsFilled THEN Reservations.Contract = &qContract ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qAgentIsFilled THEN Reservations.Agent IN HIERARCHY (&qAgent) ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qRoomIsFilled THEN Reservations.Room IN HIERARCHY (&qRoom) ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qRoomTypeIsFilled THEN Reservations.RoomType IN HIERARCHY (&qRoomType) ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qAllotmentIsFilled THEN Reservations.RoomQuota IN HIERARCHY (&qAllotment) ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qRoomRateIsFilled THEN Reservations.RoomRate IN HIERARCHY (&qRoomRate) ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qBedsSetupIsFilled THEN Reservations.BedsSetup = &qBedsSetup ELSE TRUE END AND CASE WHEN &qClientIsFilled THEN Reservations.Ref IN (&qGuestsList) ELSE TRUE END

Settings.QueryText: SELECT DocumentProformaInvoice.Ref AS Ref, DocumentProformaInvoice.DeletionMark AS DeletionMark, DocumentProformaInvoice.Number AS Number, DocumentProformaInvoice.Date AS Date, DocumentProformaInvoice.Posted AS Posted, DocumentProformaInvoice.ParentDoc AS ParentDoc, DocumentProformaInvoice.Hotel AS Hotel, DocumentProformaInvoice.Company AS Company, DocumentProformaInvoice.BankAccount AS BankAccount, DocumentProformaInvoice.AccountingCustomer AS AccountingCustomer, DocumentProformaInvoice.AccountingContract AS AccountingContract, DocumentProformaInvoice.GuestGroup AS GuestGroup, DocumentProformaInvoice.ContactPerson AS ContactPerson, DocumentProformaInvoice.Phone AS Phone, DocumentProformaInvoice.Fax AS Fax, DocumentProformaInvoice.EMail AS EMail, DocumentProformaInvoice.Sum AS Sum, DocumentProformaInvoice.VATSum AS VATSum, DocumentProformaInvoice.ExchangeRateDate AS ExchangeRateDate, DocumentProformaInvoice.AccountingCurrency AS AccountingCurrency, DocumentProformaInvoice.AccountingCurrencyExchangeRate AS AccountingCurrencyExchangeRate, DocumentProformaInvoice.Remarks AS Remarks, DocumentProformaInvoice.PrintWithCompanyStamp AS PrintWithCompanyStamp, DocumentProformaInvoice.ExternalCode AS ExternalCode, DocumentProformaInvoice.ExtraInvoice AS ExtraInvoice, DocumentProformaInvoice.CheckDate AS CheckDate, DocumentProformaInvoice.Author AS Author, DocumentProformaInvoice.ChangeDate AS ChangeDate, DocumentProformaInvoice.ChangeAuthor AS ChangeAuthor, DocumentProformaInvoice.PointInTime AS PointInTime, ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) AS PaidSum, CASE WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) <= 0 AND DocumentProformaInvoice.Hotel.AccountingDate > DocumentProformaInvoice.CheckDate AND DocumentProformaInvoice.CheckDate > DATETIME(1, 1, 1) THEN 6 WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) <= 0 THEN 1 WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) >= DocumentProformaInvoice.Sum THEN 5 WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) < DocumentProformaInvoice.Sum / 2 THEN 2 WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) = DocumentProformaInvoice.Sum / 2 THEN 3 WHEN ISNULL(InvoiceAccounts.SumExpense, 0) > DocumentProformaInvoice.Sum / 2 THEN 4 ELSE 0 END AS InvoicePayedStateIcon FROM Document.ProformaInvoice AS DocumentProformaInvoice LEFT JOIN (SELECT InvoiceAccountsTurnovers.Invoice AS Invoice, InvoiceAccountsTurnovers.SumExpense AS SumExpense FROM AccumulationRegister.InvoiceAccounts.Turnovers(, , PERIOD, GuestGroup = &qGuestGroup) AS InvoiceAccountsTurnovers) AS InvoiceAccounts ON (InvoiceAccounts.Invoice = DocumentProformaInvoice.Ref) WHERE DocumentProformaInvoice.Posted AND DocumentProformaInvoice.GuestGroup = &qGuestGroup AND DocumentProformaInvoice.GuestGroup <> VALUE(Catalog.GuestGroups.EmptyRef)
